name: Crypto markets & Hyperliquid
description: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Coinbase, Kraken, KuCoin, Gate.io, Bitget and Hyperliquid market data, with a Hyperliquid perpetuals account for the order ticket. Hyperliquid starts on testnet.

settings.label: Hyperliquid network
settings.help: Testnet uses Hyperliquid's test network. Live orders are still confirmed by OpenTrader before they are sent.

settings.label: Hyperliquid wallet private key
settings.help: Stored in the operating system's credential store, never in the settings file. Use an API (agent) wallet rather than the main wallet where possible.

settings.label: Main wallet address
settings.help: Only for an API (agent) wallet: the main account it acts for. Leave empty when the key above belongs to the trading account.

settings.label: Market order slippage (%)
settings.help: Hyperliquid has no native market order: a market order is an immediate-or-cancel limit at the mid price moved by this much.

settings.label: Refresh (seconds)
settings.help: How often live quotes and the account are refreshed when a venue has no WebSocket (the plugin streams over WebSockets when it can).

setup: Market data works at once. To trade, open the Exchanges tab under the chart, choose Hyperliquid, pick the network and paste the Hyperliquid wallet private key. Then connect the broker and turn trading on.
